quests.instruction: Coats are hung up at quarter to twelve, lunchtime almost here. What time is it?

quests.explanation: Quarter to twelve means 15 minutes before twelve, so the clock reads 11:45 AM.
quests.funFact: 11:45 AM is a hungry moment right before lunch begins.
